cāṭu: [Caṭa+ṇu] (ti) CL=10 (1) Lovely; Pleasant. (2) Speaking lovely and pleasant speech; A person. (3) Being a person who speaks lovely and pleasant (Bhāvappadhāna). See-Cāṭukamyatā.
cāṭuka: [Cāṭu+ka] (ti) CL=10 "ka" has no meaning.] Speaking lovely and pleasant speech; A person. See-Cāṭukakamma.
cāṭukakamma: [Cāṭuka+kamma] (na) CL=10 The case of a person who speaks lovely and kindly; Humility for oneself and exaltation of laity donators.
cāṭukamya: [Cāṭukāma+ṇya] (na) CL=10 As a person who wants to be a person who speak lovely and kindly; Speaking humility for oneself and praising of laity donators.
cāṭukamyatā: [Cāṭukamya+tā] (thī) CL=10 "tā" has no meaning.] A person who wants to be a person who speaks lovely and kindly; Speaking humility for oneself and praising of laity donators.
cāṭukāma: [Cāṭu+kamu+ṇa] (ti) CL=10 Wish to be a person who always speaks lovely and kindly; Wants to humble oneself and uplift the laity people; A person. See-Cāṭukamyatā.
cālesu: [Cala+ṇe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=10 "sa" insertion.] Had been made to move; Had been made to tremble; Had been made to move. See-Cāleti (D).
cāresu: [Cara+ṇe+uṃ] (kri) CL=10 "sa" insertion.] (1) has been managed. (2) has been brought. (3) has been put. See-Cāreti. Cāresuṃ (kā,kri) [cara+ṇe+uṃ. "sa" insertion.]  Has been made a spinning. See- Cāreti (2).
cāretu: [Cara+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=10 To travel; to go around; to inhabit; to graze.
cāri: [Cara+iṃ] (kri) CL=10 Have been around; Have been traveled; Have been grazed. See-Cāreti (1).
cātuyāmasavara: [Cātuyāma+saṃvara] (pu) CL=10 (1) The restraint of the four portions; Four kinds of restraint. (2) Restraining of four kinds of abstinence. See also- Cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuta.
cātuyāmasavarasavuta: [Cātuyāmasaṃvara+saṃvuta] (ti) CL=10 (1) The restraint, which is a set of four parts; Endowed with four restraints; A person. (2) All kinds of restraint. He: (2) Being restrained, well-restrained, with a set of four parts of abstinences; A person. See original.
cātuyāmasusavuta: [Cātuyāma+susaṃvuta] (ti) CL=10 Well-restrained, with a set of four parts of abstinences; Endowed with four types of restraint; A person.
cāvetu: [Cu+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=9 To be moved. (A) To be moved; To move; To relocate. (B) To relocate; To fall. (C) To be moved; To drop. (D) To be moved; To die.
